NSSDC fact sheet: mean surface gravity 9.820 m/s2, average temperature 288 K, 5.1e18 kg of dry air at 78.08% N2, 20.95% O2, 9,340 ppm Ar, 420 ppm CO2, 5.24 ppm He, 1.94 ppm CH4 and 0.55 ppm H2 by volume, split by molar mass; Ne and Kr are left out. The share of people inside the human climate niche is 1 before warming, 0.91 at +1.2 C, two thirds at +2.7 C and a half at +3.6 to 4.4 C (Lenton et al. 2023), taken at +4.0 C
